Article 4 (Management of Provincial and Municipal Environmental Information)
(1) The environmental information specified in Article 18(5) of the Act and Article 8(2)(2) of the Ordinance (hereinafter referred to as "provincial and municipal environmental information") shall include the following items: <amendment as of 2025.10.1>
1. Information on the current state of the environment in various fields, such as water, air, and natural ecosystems, collected and produced by the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing Province, the Mayor of a Metropolitan City, the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing Province, the Governor of a Province, or the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as "provincial and municipal officials").
2. Other information on the current state of the environment as determined and promulgated by the Minister of the Ministry of Climate and Energy.
(2) In addition to the items specified in (1), the Minister of the Ministry of Climate and Energy shall determine any other matters necessary for the management of provincial and municipal environmental information. <amendment as of 2025.10.1>
